_note: PaperBomb LAYOUT metrology. Numbers only; no artwork derived from the guides. Canonical space 980x2184 px = 70.0 x 156.0 mm (14 px/mm), origin at the TAG's top-left virtual corner, x right, y down. fW = fraction of tag width, fH = fraction of tag height, mm = millimetres on the 70.0 x 156.0 mm card. Colour values are STORED (file/sRGB-encoded) 0..1 values, not linear.

rectification_applied.method: 4 edge lines least-squares fitted to the outline, intersected for virtual corners, then a perspective warp of that quad onto 980x2184

geometry.centre_fit_method: iterative mid-ring re-centring (8 passes, 180 angular bins)

diamonds.rule_median_stroke_note: beads_on_rules are local width bulges along a border rule (>2x its median stroke width)
